companyDescription: Critical minerals · Elk Creek niobium/scandium/titanium project — 2nd-largest indicated US rare-earth resource · 2026 Feasibility Study complete ($4.1B pre-tax NPV8%) · $800M EXIM Bank debt financing still in review
priceNote: Live $3.02 (+0.3%) on Nov 11, 2026 — down 13% from $3.47 at the Sep 29 report. The old report sat in post-stage only because its 'H2 2026' badge parsed to a phantom Sep 15; the EXIM decision is still pending. Old Base +45% ($5.03) is replaced by a new Base +40% ($4.23) anchored to the live price.
summary: Still waiting on the one binary that matters: EXIM Bank's debt package for Elk Creek. An Oct 14, 2026 EXIM letter of support reaffirmed the intent to finance about 65% of upfront costs — now a potential ~$1.2B loan after the August feasibility study raised development costs — and EXIM says it will take the loan to its Transaction Review Committee 'as expeditiously as practicable', with final approval by the EXIM Board. No decision date is public, so this report carries no catalyst date rather than inventing one (the previous 'H2 2026' badge had parsed to a phantom Sep 15 and pushed the pick into post-stage). The stock has kept drifting lower on sector-wide rare-earth cooling despite the supportive letter. Base +40% assumes TRC and Board approval within ~6 months; Moon is the ~$11 analyst consensus. Measured turbo median return to just after the catalyst is -4.0% (n=68): prefer the dip zone. Size 1.5–2% max.

catalysts.name: EXIM Bank TRC review → Board approval (~$1.2B loan)
catalysts.description: Oct 14, 2026 EXIM letter of support reaffirmed ~65% financing of upfront costs; next is the Transaction Review Committee, then a final EXIM Board decision. No date announced.

catalysts.name: Offtake + strategic financing stack
catalysts.description: Lockheed Martin scandium MOU (Aug 2026), Traxys offtake for remaining output and the Jan 2026 ~$150M equity raise form the non-EXIM part of the capital stack.

risks: EXIM approval is the whole thesis and has no date; the process has run since a 2024 term sheet, and further delay is the base risk.
The August feasibility study raised development costs; the loan is now ~$1.2B for ~65% of upfront costs, so the equity gap and dilution grow with it.
Rare-earth and critical-mineral sentiment has cooled since the Trump–Xi summit; the stock fell even on good news (feasibility study, Lockheed MOU, EXIM letter).
Pre-revenue mine developer: any financing slip extends cash burn before production.
Analyst targets are wide (Jefferies $4.70 Hold vs ~$11 consensus), so the Moon case leans on the optimistic end.

estimateDates.note: EXIM: 'as expeditiously as practicable' — no date

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed hiked 25bp on Sep 16, 2026 (first hike since 2023), and a hot October CPI (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected) has pushed Dec 9 FOMC hike odds to roughly 89–100%, with the 10-year near 4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: October CPI ran hot (headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3%); October PCE on Nov 25 is the next inflation read.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A pre-production mine needing a ~$1.2B loan plus equity is directly exposed to higher-for-longer rates through financing cost and to risk appetite for small-cap resources.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — the thesis is a financing event, and financing gets harder and more dilutive as rates stay high.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Critical-minerals small-caps have historically run hard on Trump administration policy headlines (Project Vault, tariff/export-control news, DPA awards) even without a company-specific announcement — but NB itself has NOT shown this pattern this quarter, selling off on its own good news instead.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: days ก่อน policy headline (unpredictable timing) — though NB's own recent reactions have broken this pattern
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +10-35% historically (sector), but NB itself has recently moved the opposite way on good news

postWin.note: Sector precedent: CRML surged 35% on the Feb 2026 Project Vault announcement, USAR rose ~13% on its Serra Verde acquisition (Apr 2026). NB's own recent reactions (Feasibility Study -1.65%, Lockheed MOU -3.28%) have NOT matched this pattern — a genuine EXIM finalization would need to overcome the current sector-wide skepticism, not just be good news on its own.

postLose.note: A rejected or indefinitely delayed EXIM application would force NioCorp toward more dilutive equity financing, likely triggering a sharp de-rate given how central the $800M debt package is to the bull case; per turbo.overall stopGuidance, drawdowns of this type median around -25% for regulatory_approval catalysts (n=8) but can run deeper on financing-specific breaks.
postLose.exampleDate: Hypothetical — no direct comp found; NB's own -28% drift since July shows the downside is already partly playing out absent an actual rejection

spotSizing.reason: Single undated binary; survival not flagged but the equity gap grows with the higher loan size — low end of the band.

stopPostCatalyst.note: Exit if EXIM declines or materially cuts the loan, or the TRC review slips past mid-2027

th.summary: ยังรอ binary ตัวเดียวที่สำคัญ: วงเงินกู้จาก EXIM Bank สำหรับ Elk Creek จดหมายสนับสนุนของ EXIM วันที่ 14 ต.ค. 2026 ยืนยันเจตนาให้กู้ราว 65% ของต้นทุนเริ่มต้น — ตอนนี้วงเงินอาจราว $1.2B หลัง feasibility study เดือน ส.ค. ปรับต้นทุนขึ้น — EXIM บอกว่าจะนำเข้า Transaction Review Committee 'โดยเร็วที่สุดเท่าที่ทำได้' แล้วให้บอร์ด EXIM อนุมัติขั้นสุดท้าย ยังไม่มีวันตัดสิน รายงานนี้จึงไม่ใส่วัน catalyst แทนที่จะเดา (badge 'H2 2026' เดิมถูกแปลงเป็น 15 ก.ย. ที่ไม่มีจริงและทำให้ถูกนับว่า catalyst ผ่านไปแล้ว) หุ้นยังไหลลงตามกลุ่ม rare earth ที่เย็นลงแม้มีจดหมายสนับสนุน Base +40% สมมติว่าผ่าน TRC และบอร์ดภายใน ~6 เดือน Moon คือ consensus ~$11 ผลตอบแทน median ของ turbo ณ หลัง catalyst คือ -4.0% (n=68) ให้รอโซนย่อ แนะนำ 1.5–2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น
th.priceNote: ราคาล่าสุด $3.02 (+0.3%) วันที่ 11 พ.ย. 2026 — ลง 13% จาก $3.47 ในรายงาน 29 ก.ย. รายงานเดิมถูกนับเป็น post-stage เพราะ badge 'H2 2026' ถูกแปลงเป็น 15 ก.ย. ที่ไม่มีจริง การตัดสินของ EXIM ยังค้างอยู่ Base เดิม +45% ($5.03) ถูกแทนด้วย Base ใหม่ +40% ($4.23) คิดจากราคาล่าสุด
